_comment: What each on-page placeholder needs before launch. Keys must match the literal {{...}} text in the built HTML.
{{REGION}}: The cloud region the hosted sandbox actually runs in. Brief §5 requires it stated wherever the sandbox is offered — a sovereignty vendor asking a regulated buyer to send data somewhere unnamed is an obvious problem.
{{TBD}}: Prices (Intent Studio Team/Business/Enterprise, pilot fee, stack pricing) and the registered office line on /company. Brief §9 says publish the structure, hold the numbers — so the structure is live and every figure is marked.
{{CONFIRM}}: Whether SSO/SAML and SCIM actually ship. Zero evidence found anywhere in the repo. Do not put these in a tier table until confirmed.
{{CONFIRM BUILD STATE}}: Same question on /status — SSO / SAML, SCIM, RBAC.
{{ISO 27001 or SOC 2}}: Pick exactly one and name it. Brief §14: follow the pipeline, start one, never publish a date.
{{FORM_ENDPOINT}}: Where /early-access and the Cerebrio list post to. Must be self-hosted or a processor you are willing to list on /sub-processors — no third-party form widget, per brief §11.
{{SDLC_DETAIL}}: Secure-SDLC specifics on /trust block 05: scanning cadence, signing method, patch SLAs.
{{DISCLOSURE_TIMELINES}}: Acknowledgement and remediation windows for the vulnerability disclosure policy.
{{SANDBOX_SUBPROCESSOR_LIST}}: The actual sub-processors behind the hosted sandbox. Self-hosted has none; the sandbox does, and the list must be complete.
{{PENDING LEGAL REVIEW}}: Full privacy notice and website/sandbox terms. Everything currently on those pages is factually accurate; the formal notices are not written. Do not substitute boilerplate.
{{NOT WRITTEN YET}}: Security overview, questionnaire answer pack, incident response plan. Brief §5 rung 0 wants these ungated — they do not exist yet, and the page says so rather than hiding them behind a form.
_outOfBand: **Real artifacts.** The strongest proof on the site — a signed attestation, live egress-probe output, a real audit-log line — is deliberately absent. None exists in this repo and hard constraint #1 forbids inventing one. When Precepta can emit real output, home §5 and /trust block 03 are where it goes.
**301 redirects** from preceptaai.com → /precepta and intent.preceptaai.com → /intent-studio, preserving deep paths.
**DNS**: app.liminalabs.in (Sign in) and docs.liminalabs.in (Docs) are linked in the nav and footer but do not resolve yet. Currently live: preceptaai.com and intent.preceptaai.com.

**Contact address** is still hello@preceptaai.com, which makes Precepta look like the parent. Move to a Limina Labs address once the domain is live — it appears in the footer, /trust, /company, /sub-processors and security.txt.
**TLS**: support 1.2 as well as 1.3. The current Intent Studio host is 1.3-only and refuses 1.2, which breaks the TLS-inspecting corporate proxies these buyers sit behind.
**Analytics**: self-hosted and cookieless (Plausible, Umami or equivalent), or none. The site currently makes zero external requests — keep it that way.
**security.txt** expiry is set to 2027-08-31; refresh it annually or it becomes invalid.
